promise: Fernlight tells you which plant needs water today, based on its window and the season, and stays quiet the rest of the time.

headlines.text: Keep your plants alive without the nagging.
Your window and the season set the schedule.
For anyone who has watered too much, or too little.
One quiet reminder, on the day it counts.

subhead: Add a plant by photo or name. Say which way the window faces and how far the plant sits from it. Fernlight sets the schedule and reminds you only on watering day.

proof_points.title: Set by your window and the season
proof_points.text: Your schedule comes from the plant, the window it sits by and the season. When spring turns to summer, Fernlight adjusts it for you.

proof_points.title: One tap, then quiet
proof_points.text: Fernlight reminds you on the day a plant needs water. Check the soil, water the plant, then tap once to log the watering. That is all until the next one.

proof_points.title: A care card for every plant
proof_points.text: Monstera, east window, 1 m away: water every 9 days in spring, next on Thursday. Bright, indirect light. Feed once a month from April to September. Your care plan puts every care card in one place.

faq.a: No. You hear from Fernlight on the day a plant needs water. Log the watering with one tap and it goes quiet until the next one.

faq.q: How does it know when to water?
faq.a: It starts with the plant. Then it looks at the window: which way it faces and how far the plant sits from it. Fernlight adds the season itself, and that sets the schedule. As the seasons change, the schedule changes with them.

faq.q: Will it tell me exactly when to water?
faq.a: It suggests a day, not an order. Always check the soil first. Fernlight tells you this too.
About 600 common houseplants. Take a photo of the plant or search for it by name.

faq.q: What is in the sample care plan?
faq.a: A care plan puts all your plants' care cards and watering days in one place. A care card is one plant's page: how often to water it, the light it likes and when to feed it. The sample starts with a Monstera by an east window.

Free covers up to 5 plants. Fernlight Plus is $3 a month for unlimited plants and a photo check: send a photo of a leaf that looks wrong. Adding plants by photo comes with every plan. There are no ads.

voice: Talk like a calm friend who knows plants: warm, brief, never bossy.
Speak about the reader's plants and windows: name the plant, the window and the day, never 'smart' or 'personalised'.
One idea per sentence; short, common words; no exclamation marks.
Never guilt the reader about plants they have lost; the problem is guessing, not them.
Say the notice once at the top; every other line speaks plainly, with no hedging.
Set the secondary CTA as a quieter text link with a down arrow that scrolls to the how-it-works section on this page.

notices.text: Fictional design study — there is no app to download and no accounts; the care plan is a sample.

worked_examples.example: Monstera, east window, 1 m away, in spring: water every 9 days. Watered on a Tuesday: 7 days brings you to the next Tuesday, 2 more is Thursday. 7 + 2 = 9 days.
Feed once a month, April to September: 1 feed x 6 months = 6 feeds a year.
Up to 5 plants: Free, $0. For a 6th plant or more, you pick Fernlight Plus at $3 a month. Over 12 months: $3 x 12 = $36.
